_comment: Example rig config. Every number is a placeholder: survey your own rig. Units: metres, radians. camera.camera_height_m: camera above the marker plane; bots.<id>.led_height: LED height minus marker height (negative below). Both feed the LED-height correction (intrinsics take precedence over camera_height_m). camera: the lab's Basler acA3088-57um at full resolution (calibration/README.md, 'This rig's camera'); exposure null leaves it to the camera, so set <= 2 ms in pylon Viewer and save it as the startup user set. camera_height_m 3.6 is the least that fits a 1 m arena with this 16 mm lens: measure yours.

90.reference_point: marker centre (set marker_offset to use the body centre)
